data.body:
Operator decision (2026-08-19): title updated to match the APPROVED design comment (2026-08-18), which is the most accurate statement of this ticket's status.

The previous title ("Audit code-review Pass-3 decider drop-rate on regression/edge-cases (verifier recall loss)") described the open-ended investigation that PRECEDED the approved design. That investigation has already produced its answer — the user-approved design recorded in the 2026-08-18 comment — so a title still framed as an audit made the ticket read as unclaimable research when the concrete change set is in fact settled.

Scope of this ticket is now the approved change set:
  a1 — freq_mult amplify-only reshape
  a2 — version-signal gating
  proposal-3 — targeted impact_code boost for deletion-impact/api-compat findings that cite a REMOVED public symbol together with a named broken caller (the citric-preregal-ladybird case, which sat at priority 0.30 below the approved 0.60/0.51 flips)

Any residual open-ended recall auditing beyond this change set should be filed separately rather than re-widening this ticket.
